tasks.label: Conan: Install
tasks.detail: Wipes build/, installs deps, configures both presets

tasks.label: Conan: Install (Offline)
tasks.detail: Wipes build/, installs deps from local cache only — no downloads

tasks.label: Conan: Sync Dependencies
tasks.detail: Install deps and reconfigure CMake without wiping build/ — faster after conanfile.py changes

tasks.label: Conan: Reinstall (Clean)
tasks.detail: Purge entire Conan package cache then reinstall from scratch

tasks.label: Conan: Create Lockfile
tasks.detail: Pin all dep versions to conan.lock — run after changing conanfile.py
tasks.command: bash -c 'case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) ARCH=x86_64;; aarch64|arm64) ARCH=arm64;; *) echo "Error: Unsupported architecture $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1;; esac && LOCKFILE_ARG=$([ -f conan.lock ] && echo "--lockfile=conan.lock" || echo "") && conan lock create . --profile=conan/profiles/${ARCH}/release $LOCKFILE_ARG --lockfile-out=conan.lock'

tasks.label: CMake: Configure
tasks.detail: Run cmake --preset for the selected build type

tasks.label: CMake: Build All
tasks.detail: Configure and build all targets for the selected build type

tasks.label: CMake: Build Target...
tasks.detail: Configure then build a single named CMake target

tasks.label: Format: C++
tasks.detail: Auto-format all C++ source files with clang-format

tasks.label: Format: CMake
tasks.detail: Auto-format all CMakeLists.txt and .cmake files with gersemi

tasks.label: CMake: Run Tests
tasks.detail: Build then run all CTest tests for the selected build type

tasks.label: Lint: C++
tasks.detail: Run clang-tidy static analysis on all project source

tasks.label: Docs: Build
tasks.detail: Run Doxygen then Sphinx — HTML site written to docs/_build/html/

tasks.label: CI: Check Format (C++)
tasks.detail: Dry-run clang-format — fails if any file needs reformatting
tasks.command: find libs proto tests -type f \( -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.hpp' \) | xargs -r clang-format-18 --dry-run --Werror

tasks.label: CI: Check Format (CMake)
tasks.detail: Dry-run gersemi — fails if any CMake file needs reformatting

tasks.label: CI: Proto Lint
tasks.detail: Run buf lint — checks proto style and API rules

tasks.label: CI: Docs Check
tasks.detail: Run Doxygen (undoc warnings as errors) then Sphinx — mirrors the CI docs job
tasks.command: mkdir -p docs/_build/doxygen && doxygen docs/Doxyfile && LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 LANG=C.UTF-8 sphinx-build -W -b html docs docs/_build/html

tasks.label: CI: Proto Breaking Changes
tasks.detail: Run buf breaking against origin/main — catches wire-incompatible proto changes before push
tasks.command: if git ls-remote --exit-code origin main 2>/dev/null && git ls-tree -r origin/main --name-only | grep -q '\.proto$'; then buf breaking --against '.git#branch=origin/main'; else echo 'No proto files on origin/main — skipping.'; fi

tasks.label: CI: Check All
tasks.detail: Run all fast CI checks in parallel (format, lint, proto lint, proto breaking changes, docs)
